# Primal Champion (`features:barbarian-primal-champion`)
**Class:** [Barbarian](../classes/barbarian.md) | **Level:** [Barbarian 20](../levels/barbarian-20.md)

You embody primal power. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.
